verification.notes: Transcript context at 00:03:32 was reviewed. Contemporary reporting confirms that Owens publicly accused Erika Kirk and a family friend of planting or spearheading the article, but it also records denials and an unresolved dispute. No editorial records, communications, or named firsthand evidence establish that they planted the Daily Mail story or coordinated the alleged DARVO response.
